dedupe_keys.name: plugwise 2 m iti smart plug acquisition code

description: Plugwise-2-py is a monitoring and control server for Plugwise smart plugs. The GitLab README describes ten-second logging, buffered meter readings, switch commands and MQTT topics; the project tree also contains Python source and a licence file. A modeller can use its measurement and control interface to produce appliance demand traces or connect a physical home-energy testbed to a simulation. The code depends on compatible Plugwise devices and its old repository does not demonstrate current hardware support. Live switching commands should be tested separately before connecting real equipment. The repository licence file is GNU GPL version 3. I read the public project metadata, tree, README and licence header without installing or operating devices. The related SustDataED2 dataset is a separate collection of measured traces. No exact catalogue platform record was found.
